title: Quantum Natural Family Planning Pilot
brief_summary: •The Pilot study will involve current Marquette Method users who own and use a ClearBlue Fertility monitor and who will be asked to simultaneously use the Mira monitor for the sake of comparing the two devices to monitor the menstrual cycle.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* • Menstrual cycle ranging between 21-42 days

  * At least 3 cycles after cessation of breastfeeding

Exclusion Criteria:

* • Not currently on medications that affect ovulation and 3 months prior

  * Not currently pregnant or breastfeeding
  * No known fertility problems
  * Not planning on achieving pregnancy during the 3 menstrual cycles of the study
